canonicalTarget: One chat-first Mission Control backed by authenticated server routes and durable mission state

findings.backend: browser-first Pi web runtime with Node-only capability stubs
findings.gap: Not a full Pauli control plane; server-only data/integration/runtime paths are stubbed.
findings.resolution: Absorb chat into server-backed Mission Control.

findings.surface: Hosted Pi Web Chat secret boundary
findings.gap: Provider/service credentials can be included in public browser artifacts when present.
findings.resolution: Remove browser credential injection; use authenticated server-side broker; scan built assets.

findings.gap: Agents, projects, approvals, builds, judge decisions and watcher alerts are static demo/local state.
findings.resolution: Wire to real mission/control API, approvals, evidence and durable state.

findings.gap: Real run/status/stop behavior is not exposed through canonical Mission Control.
findings.resolution: Keep as migration bridge behind authenticated server routes.

findings.gap: Live child-process handles are in memory even though job JSON persists.
findings.resolution: Use durable workflow/task state for long-running missions and explicit restart recovery.

findings.gap: Historical deployment is not sourced from current repo; its /mission-control is missing and live search is broken.
findings.resolution: Fold useful memory/search views into canonical current-repo Mission Control.

findings.gap: Client uses anon insert while migration grants writes to service_role; errors are swallowed.
findings.resolution: Server-side authenticated write path with matching RLS/audit error handling.

findings.gap: Separate repo can be mistaken for this agent's canonical control UI.
findings.resolution: Label sibling/legacy and remove control ownership ambiguity.

designGate.nextAfterFix: Generate five divergent Mission Control candidates, then quality gates and Gauntlet comparison.
